Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9844 of 2023
Applicant :- Ankur Mishra

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Secrett. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Dinesh Kumar Shukla,Ajai Kumar Shukla,Nisha Devi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Vinod Kumar Pandey

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State as well as Sri Vinod Kumar Pandey, the counsel for the informant and perused the record.
2.
The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.98 of 2023 under sections 376(2)(N), 316, 506 IPC, P.S. Chhapiya, District Gonda.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that from the last three years, the applicant had formed physical relations with the informant on the false pretext of marriage.
It was also stated that two years' ago, an abortion was also done on the informant.
Ankur Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

entities.text: Ankur Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C also, she reiterated that on the false pretext of marriage, physical relations were formed and the victim was carrying a fetus of five months.

5. In the light of the said, the counsel for the applicant relies upon the judgment of the Supreme Court in the case of Deepak Gulati vs Tate of Haryana; 2013 (7) SCC 675.
6.

entities.text: Deepak Gulati vs Tate of Haryana; 2013 (7) SCC 675
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The counsel for the informant opposes the bail application by arguing that the informant has delivered a child, however, considering the allegations levelled in the FIR as well as in the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C., prima-facie, only the allegations are that on false pretext of marriage,
physical relations were formed which continued over a span of three years.

7. Considering the law as explained in the case of Deepak Gulati (supra) coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in jail since 07.06.2023, the applicant is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Ankur Mishra be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.2.2024 VNP/-
